installation: the release wheel in an environment outside the checkout
title: Cost of a design iteration: stage times, cold and warm, resident and streamed, batched and sequential, autotuning break-even

fixture.synchronization: each stage bounded by a CUDA synchronization; overlapping asynchronous work is not summed
fixture.cold: first iteration of a fresh process
comparisons: three wavelengths as one tensor batch against three sequential runs
fixture.tuning: policy autotuner cost and break-even iteration count

seed: the G7-01 and G7-03 seed 1 starts
reference_method: the recorded medians become the regression baseline

acceptance.stages: every stage recorded with median and range for cold and warm iterations
acceptance.comparisons: streamed and batched comparisons recorded even where slower
acceptance.regression: a test flags a later run whose stage median exceeds 1.25 times the recorded baseline
